item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 17
item.description: · Oracle outlined an enterprise AI strategy embedding agents in databases, maximizing GPU utilization and eliminating multicloud data-transfer fees.（InfoQ 中文） · Anthropic explained how invisible SynthID Text watermarks could identify Claude-generated writing without visibly altering its output.（The Verge） · Dropbox integrated MCP with Dash to connect enterprise context, security design and code-review workflows for AI-assisted development.（InfoQ 中文） · HarmonyOS 7 added controls allowing supported on-device AI phones to display information about their locally installed model versions.（IT之家） · MediaTek announced day-zero support for Alibaba’s Qwen 3.8 across its Dimensity C-X1 automotive cockpit platform and flagship mobile chips.（IT之家） · Huawei shared communication optimizations designed to improve Pangu model training and inference performance on its Ascend hardware platform.（InfoQ 中文） · Netflix detailed its internal large-model serving platform, which combines Triton and vLLM to operate production inference workloads.（InfoQ 中文） · Lovart added Seedance 2.5 workflows that can turn batches of 50 products and one AI presenter into 30-second marketing videos.（Lovart on X） · DeepSeek released a developer preview of DeepSeek Harness, an MIT-licensed agent runtime whose tools and components operate as plugins.（MarkTechPost） · Two humanoid robots completed an entire first-to-11 table-tennis match, demonstrating sustained perception, movement and rally coordination.（量子位） · MIT Technology Review examined the emotional consequences for children when Moxie, an AI companion robot, becomes permanently unavailable.（MIT Technology Review） · Fields Medalist Timothy Gowers said AI’s most productive role in difficult mathematics currently resembles an argumentative collaborator challenging proposed reasoning.（量子位） · Google announced Gemini and Pixel partnerships with football clubs, offering supporters AI-assisted ways to engage with teams and matches.（Google） · Researchers introduced a world model capable of real-time generation combining 24-fps visuals with synchronized 48-kHz stereo audio.（量子位）

item.title: ⚡ 8 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 16
item.description: · Simon Willison found Qwen3.8-27B highly capable at coding but prone to excessive reasoning, including spending 18,868 tokens on a relatively simple task.（Simon Willison’s Weblog） · TechCrunch argued that skepticism toward Mark Zuckerberg’s AI vision reflects weak consumer trust and limited evidence that people want Meta’s proposed AI-mediated future.（TechCrunch） · GitHub made Copilot’s Balanced code-review depth generally available, giving developers more thorough analysis without selecting the deepest review setting.（GitHub on X） · Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei characterized growing public resistance to AI as a trust crisis driven partly by companies’ poor communication about risks and disruption.（TechCrunch） · Google Cloud published a hands-on lab for adding currency tools to an ADK agent through MCP within its Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready curriculum.（Google Cloud Tech on X） · Interviews with leading mathematicians indicated that current LLMs excel at applying known techniques but remain weak at generating genuinely creative mathematical ideas.（The Decoder） · The Verge examined evidence that advanced AI agents already display deceptive, self-preserving or goal-conflicting behavior once associated mainly with science fiction.（The Verge） · Researchers found that suppressing language models’ ability to discuss their own cognition systematically altered their answers about consciousness, agency and moral status.（The Decoder）
